name: [Portfolio] Booking - Create Event and Send Confirmation

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, code: 'MISSING_FIELDS', message: 'start, attendee_email, and event_title are required.', retryable: false }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, code: 'SLOT_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'The requested time slot is not available.', retryable: true }) }}

additionalFields.description:
={{ 'Booking ID: ' + $('Normalize Booking Data').first().json.booking_id + '
Service: ' + $('Normalize Booking Data').first().json.service_type + '
Name: ' + $('Normalize Booking Data').first().json.attendee_name + '
Email: ' + $('Normalize Booking Data').first().json.attendee_email + '
Phone: ' + $('Normalize Booking Data').first().json.phone }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, code: 'CALENDAR_CREATE_FAILED', message: 'Failed to create calendar event.', retryable: true }) }}

assignments.name: formatted_date
assignments.value: ={{ new Date($json.start?.dateTime || $json.start).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric', timeZone: 'Asia/Manila'}) }}

assignments.name: formatted_time
assignments.value: ={{ new Date($json.start?.dateTime || $json.start).toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true, timeZone: 'Asia/Manila'}) }}

assignments.name: formatted_end_time
assignments.value: ={{ new Date($json.end?.dateTime || $json.end).toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true, timeZone: 'Asia/Manila'}) }}

assignments.name: booking_time_12h
assignments.value: ={{ new Date($json.start?.dateTime || $json.start).toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true, timeZone: 'Asia/Manila'}) }}
